column1: # modal-census-appendix.tsv — committed expected values for the `modals` check in
# `--appendix FILE` mode: the floor to apply to the appendix artifact.
# Same token set and counting command as modal-census.tsv:
# Floor derived from `PROTOCOL.md` at 526 lines / md5 63de15a37a42ce57decb951a7e8aa2f0:
# the `## Appendix — incident digest (why these rules exist)` section carried 15 of the
# file's 120 normative tokens, so the digest must carry those 15 after it moves.
# The body floors in modal-census.tsv are unchanged and stay the body's expected values;
# in appendix mode this file supplies the one floor applied to the artifact.
# Key semantics: the key is the ASCII prefix `## Appendix`; the check opens the section
# at the first line starting with the key and closes it at the next `## ` line. An
# artifact with no `## ` heading at all is counted whole (the artifact *is* the digest)
# — the missing heading itself is reported by the `structure` check.
